card.name: Resuming and 'prior to' in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: The word resume, and the word to after prior, in label instructions about restarting a drug or doing a step before another. It also fires on some commas and nouns inside overdose symptom or procedure lists.

modes.label: Resume after interruption
modes.description: The verb resume when a drug is restarted after a hold or missed dose.
modes.example: If recovered to baseline or ≤ Grade 2 within 14 days,<< resume>> TEPMETKO at a reduced dose

modes.label: Prior to a step
modes.description: The word to after prior, before a named procedure or initiation.
modes.example: gastrointestinal decontamination. This should include large volume gastric lavage followed by activated charcoal. If consciousness is impaired, the airway should be secured prior<< to>> lavage. EMESIS IS CONTRA

modes.label: Overdose lists
modes.description: Commas or nouns inside lists of overdose signs or causes.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE Acute onset of chills, hypotension<<,>> renal insufficiency, thromboc
